reports.summary:
I closed every item on the D-menus work list.

1. **S08 placement.** There is now one source for where a menu row sits: `MXRPopupStyle.rowTop(_:in:)` / `submenuTop(_:in:submenu:)` in MXRPopupStyle.swift. The presenter's `rowFrame`, the S10 `ContextSubmenuComposition` and the S08/S68 `AppSubmenuComposition` all use it. The S08 Open Recent submenu used to sit 48 pt too high; its first row now lines up with the Open Recent row. S68 is unchanged: still REVIEW, with the same 38×12 pt shortcut-column difference as before.

2. **Subtitle Earlier / Later.** In the right-click › Subtitle menu (and the native Subtitles menu, which mirrors it), these rows now show VLC's subtitle delay keys. They are bound to `subdelay-down` / `subdelay-up`, one 50 ms step, the same step the row's action takes. They also follow a rebinding.

3. **S09 shortcut column.** C-bridge has switched the mock to VLC's macOS defaults. The S09/S10 render now shows ⌘. Stop, ⌘← / ⌘→, ⇧⌘R Record, ⌘\ Hide UI, ⌘Q, and H / J for the subtitle delay. That matches what the VLC backend reads from the `__APPLE__` block in src/libvlc-module.c. I recorded the departure from Figma's bare S/P/N/R in a new D034 bullet: bare S is VLC's macOS subtitle-track key, and ⌘P would be Print.

4. **Already fixed in HEAD:**
   - The Swift 6 `preferredSize` warning: `onboardingBackRect` is `@MainActor`, and a fresh compile of MXRGalleryCatalog gives no warnings.
   - The dead `rescan-plugins` action: it is gone from AppModel.

5. **DialogKeyLoopTests.** The test now gives the New Playlist dialog's own name field the keyboard before it sends Tab, so each Tab really goes through the key loop.

**Tests.** The new tests fail without the fixes and pass with them. I checked this in an isolated copy with both fixes reverted: Open Recent placement failed, the subtitle shortcut assertions failed (3), and Profile placement still passed, as expected. The D-menus suites pass: PopupMenuTests, MenuAuditRegressionTests, NativeMenuMirrorTests, ShortcutDefaultsTests, MenuExtensionsAndShadowTests, AnchoredPopupPinPolicyTests, FigmaDeviationTests (35 + 7), DialogKeyLoopTests, and the new tests. `swift build` is clean.
fixed: (d)/(a) S08 parity minor-diff + critic P2 + verifier open #1: Open Recent submenu drawn 48 pt above its row. Root cause: a hand-written (row-1)*rowHeight offset. Fix: MXRPopupStyle.rowTop/submenuTop is now the one row-geometry source, used by the presenter's rowFrame and by both gallery compositions. Evidence: ../build/evidence/final5/polish/D-menus/S08-before.png (2x, card top 241 pt vs row 292 pt) and S08-after.png (card top 288 pt + 4 pt padding = row top 292 pt); S68 unchanged: S68-check/side-by-side.png and report.txt (REVIEW, the same local 38x12 pt shortcut-column area as before).

S10 parity note: Subtitle Earlier/Later showed no key. They now show VLC's subdelay-down/subdelay-up bindings (macOS H / J) in the right-click submenu and the native Subtitles menu. Evidence: ../build/evidence/final5/polish/D-menus/S09-S10-subtitle-macos-keys.png

(d) S09 shortcut column after C-bridge's mock fix: the gallery now shows the installed app's keys (⌘. Stop, ⌘← Previous, ⌘→ Next, ⇧⌘R Record, ⌘\ Hide UI, ⌘Q, Space), from the src/libvlc-module.c __APPLE__ block (KEY_STOP Command+., KEY_PREV/NEXT Command+Left/Right, KEY_RECORD Command+Shift+r). 'Record ⇧R vs R' is resolved to ⇧⌘R in both. The difference from Figma's bare letters is covered by the amended D034. Evidence: S09-S10-subtitle-macos-keys.png

(d) Swift 6 'preferredSize referenced from a nonisolated context' warning: already fixed in HEAD (CustomizationGallery.onboardingBackRect is @MainActor). A forced recompile of MXRGalleryCatalog and a full swift build show no warnings.
F-settings note: the dead 'rescan-plugins' action in AppModel is already gone (performSettingsAction has no such case; only rescan-library remains).

F-settings note: DialogKeyLoopTests now gives the New Playlist name field the keyboard before sending Tab, so the Tab presses really go through the dialog's key loop (Tests/MXRUISnapshotTests/DialogIsolationTests.swift).

issues.description: When no repo marker is found above a start directory, the loop never ends. At '/', deletingLastPathComponent() returns '/../', so `parent.path == dir.path` is never true. A package copy outside the repo hangs FigmaDeviationTests and the snapshot tests forever (seen here: 36 min) instead of throwing the 'set MXR_REPO_ROOT' error. Owner of MXRGalleryCatalog/integrator: compare standardized paths, or stop at '/'.

These tests read src/libvlc-module.c and module/MXRAppOptions.inc through #filePath-relative paths, so they fail in an isolated package copy. They pass in the shared tree. Informational only: isolated runs of these suites need the shared tree.

verdict.summary:
I verified D-menus independently on the working tree over ddd9d23a9d. The fixer's claims hold.

Work list:
- (d) S08 placement: fixed at the root. MXRPopupStyle.rowTop(_:in:) and submenuTop(_:in:submenu:) are now the single row-geometry source. The presenter's rowFrame, ContextSubmenuComposition and AppSubmenuComposition all use it. Tokens only. My render r/S08_RecentSubmenu_default.png shows the first history row level with Open Recent (top at 292 pt). S68 still lines up: Movies is level with Profile, and the check is REVIEW with the same 38×12 pt shortcut-column area as before.
- (d) Swift 6 'preferredSize' warning: gone. onboardingBackRect is @MainActor. I touched the D-menus files and rebuilt: no warnings.
- (d) S09 shortcut column: the render shows Space, ⌘., ⌘←, ⌘→, ⇧⌘R, ⌘\ and ⌘Q (check/S09/side-by-side.png). I checked these against the __APPLE__ block of src/libvlc-module.c: KEY_STOP Command+., KEY_PREV/NEXT Command+Left/Right, KEY_RECORD Command+Shift+r, KEY_SUBDELAY_DOWN/UP h/j. 'Record ⇧R vs R' now resolves to ⇧⌘R, as the installed app will show.
- (a) S10: Subtitle Earlier and Later now show H and J, follow a rebinding, and the native Subtitles menu mirrors them (r/S10_subtitle.png). The submenu's top lines up with the Subtitle row. Bare H and J in the native menu go through MXRKeyRouting.shouldPerformMenuEquivalent, which blocks them while a text field is being edited.
- (b) Critic P2 (S08): closed. The D051, D055, D039 and D053 critic items are owned by A-window and the control/track areas, and no D-menus file excuses them.
- (c) Verifier open #1 (S08) and #2 (the warning): closed. F-settings' notes: rescan-plugins is gone; DialogKeyLoopTests now focuses the New Playlist name field before sending Tab.

D034 amendment ('Right-click menu keys'): justified. The rows show the engine's real bindings. Figma's bare S/P/N/R are the Windows defaults, and on the Mac they would clash with VLC's own keys (bare S is the subtitle-track key) or with ⌘P Print. Changing them would mean changing engine defaults or showing keys the product does not have. It is not an excuse for a fixable visual difference.

Tests:
- Shared tree: AppSubmenuPlacementTests, SubtitleDelayMenuShortcutTests, PopupMenuTests, MenuAuditRegressionTests, NativeMenuMirrorTests, MenuExtensionsAndShadowTests, AnchoredPopupPinPolicyTests, DialogKeyLoopTests and FigmaDeviationTests: 40/40 pass. ShortcutDefaultsTests, MockShortcutDefaultsTests, SpaceAfterEndTests, ExtensionMenuObservationTests and AppActionFeedbackTests: 15/15 pass.
- Revert check in an isolated copy (deleted afterwards), with both fixes undone: the Open Recent test fails (submenu row at 245 pt, parent row at 292 pt), the subtitle-key test fails 3 assertions, and the Profile test still passes. The new tests do catch the bugs.
- One transient: during the isolated run, FigmaDeviationTests failed on S71.Onboarding/shortcuts ('outside the entry'). That comes from another area's in-progress CustomizationGallery work, and the test passes in the current shared tree.

Neighbour checks:
- S07: REVIEW, shortcut glyphs only.
- S29: REVIEW, the 70×16 pt area already covered by D034.
- S32 sort: PASS.
- S68 Profiles list: REVIEW, the 11×11 pt corner, as before.

Other checks:
- Ownership: the only edits outside D-menus files (DialogIsolationTests.swift and one DECISIONS bullet) are declared.
- The engine is untouched: `git diff upstream-base-2026-10-14 -- src lib include modules/gui/macosx` is empty.
- No masks or Settings-gate changes in D-menus files.

Evidence is in ../build/evidence/final5/polish/D-menus-verify-r1/ (r/, check/S09/, tests.log, tests-shared.log, revert.log).
